simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מְלוּנָה (H4412) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מְלוּנָה (mᵉlûwnâh) means a hut , a hammock First listed occurrence: Isa 1 8.

definitions.full: H4412. melunah מְלוּנָה noun feminine lodge, hut ; — ׳מ בְּמִקְשָׁה Isa 1:8 (i.e. a watchman's hut); simile of frail, insecure structure וְהִתְנוֺדֲדָה בַּמְּלוּנָה 24:20 and it [the earth] shall shake (or totter ) like a hut.
